impact.rationale: Owner requested slimmer current-story validation on 2026-11-08, superseding the earlier NEXT-time direction. The core diff extends desktop-specific feature gates and profiles while preserving narrower legacy semantics. Five already-completed desktop cases, ordinary graph boot, both host suites and 16 separate builds are re-reviewed against unchanged implementation/tool inputs. Fresh focused boundary, scheduler, capabilities, waits and SDK-runtime guests exercise shared consumers. This is bounded story closeout, not fresh M1/M3 milestone acceptance; failed and interrupted full attempts remain non-passes.

Five desktop repetitions retain all new lifecycle/negative/count criteria.
